name: Best Friends
source:
"What have I ever done to them, to deserve this?"

"There are three friends: Sakura, Len and Hirana. Sakura would never BETRAY her friends. But what if her friends betrayed her?"

[From [url=https://pastelle-studios.itch.io/best-friends]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我到底对他们做了什么，要承受这样的惩罚？”

“有三个朋友：小樱、连和平菜。小樱永远不会背叛她的朋友。但是如果她的朋友背叛了她怎么办？”

[来自[url=https://pastelle-studios.itch.io/best-friends]Itch.io[/url]]
